next_action: Run docs/CODEX-V13-FINAL-INTEGRATION-RUN.md once in the existing prepared environment at exact tested integration I, retaining original controller execution at S. Save a separate destination receipt, including actual Cloud latency and any Windows gate left NOT_RUN. Use docs/LOCAL-POWERSHELL-V13.md for the actual Windows receiver. local_integration.destination_acceptance_rule: One real destination receive validates the new receiver; it is not a new model run, controller initialization or research continuation.
